name: Iseya Masataka
source:
"See, it looks like your husband is enjoying it that much, right?"

The husband of the neighbor couple living in the same apartment complex as the Yoshioka couple. 
He has a job as the president of a small company, but the details are unknown. It seems he is at home during the day. He has dark skin and a muscular build like a trainer, yet he has a physique that looks like he also has some body fat. 
Despite being middle-aged, he has a strong sex drive, and apparently has sex almost every night.

[Translated from [url=https://www.hs-crowd.co.jp/anim/product/pro_pc/pc036/syoukai.html]the official site[/url]]
